messages:
ana_rodriguez: Quick sync — EU data-transfer / cross-border controls for the Snowbridge connector + Databricks vector parity before marketplace listing. Need legal signoff on SCCs, data residency flag, and an ops runbook. cc @jordan_snow @rav_databricks
mike_chen: On it. Do we have the final SCC wording from legal? I have an older draft.
leigh_han: we need to confirm which metadata we persist in the connector (user ids vs anon tokens). That impacts PII scope.
suresh_patel: From infra side: private deployment option will need KMS integration doc. I can draft steps for KMS + HSM flow.
katie_pm: Timeline constraint: marketplace listing ETA is next Wednesday EOD. Legal needs 48 hours to review.
jordan_snow: Snow engineering has a compliance checklist we can share. I'll attach the link in a moment. We prefer `data_location` attribute at ingestion time.
rav_databricks: DBX vector team: model embeddings are fine, but we need explicit opt-in for sending metadata to outbound connectors. We'll add a toggle in config.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: reminder — last marketplace build scheduled for 2024-07-18 02:00 UTC (:calendar:)
ops-bot: (system) please ensure schema compatibility tests pass: `tests/connector/snowbridge/schema_compat.py`
ops-bot: build log: https://ci.redwood/1234/console — failing on `schema_compat` on staging env
mike_chen: I see the failing test — column `user_ref` expected nullable but non-nullable in staging. Quick fix: make `user_ref` `nullable=True` in extractor mapping. Pushing PR now.
leigh_han: Legal update from katie? Are SCCs OK if we enforce EU region pinning and KMS?
katie_pm: Legal: SCCs ok + we need explicit customer consent for cross-border telemetry. Add a checkbox in onboarding and a note in marketplace listing copy.
suresh_patel: KMS runbook draft: https://docs.redwood/kms-runbook — includes HSM key rotation, IAM roles, and sample terraform. Will add section on region restrictions.
jordan_snow: I'll coordinate the joint announcement wording once legal confirms. Prefer "regional data controls" phrasing, not "no-export".
mike_chen: PR merged for nullable user_ref. Rerun CI.
ops-bot: CI passed on staging. All green.
katie_pm: Great. Next steps: 1) finalize legal copy (katie) 2) ops runbook link (suresh) 3) DBX opt-in toggle in config (rav) 4) announcement draft (jordan). Meeting tomorrow 10:00 UTC to sign off. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: scheduled meeting created: invites sent to participants.
ops-bot: thread closed by ana_rodriguez.
